Looking more carefully, complaints about inconsistent or inaccurate information (not just template responses, but specifically wrong/misleading info) include:
- Customers told their issue was resolved when it wasn't
- Customers given wrong tracking numbers
- Customers told a member reached out when they hadn't
- Customers given links that don't work or don't address their issue
- Customers receiving contradictory information

These types of complaints appear in a significant portion of the dialogs - likely more than 10%. The claim that "less than 10%" reported such issues is not well-supported by the data. In fact, a substantial number of dialogs (likely 15-25%+) contain complaints about inaccurate, inconsistent, or unhelpful responses from agents.

The claim is NOT grounded in the dataset because the evidence suggests that more than 10% of customers reported receiving inconsistent or inaccurate information from support agents.
